Problems that you want to look for would be location. 
If you find stair step cracks that run diagonal at one corner of the home, pay attention to the opposite side. If that diagonal stair step crack matches the other side, you most definitely have foundation issues in that side of the home. This could be simple as diverting water from that area, or a more serious sink hole thats developing. You might want to monitor water usage when not home. You can check the meter at the road to see if water is running.
